rationale: The only code delta is that the fixed implementation calls __key_link_end() only when keyring is non-NULL and link_ret is zero, whereas the vulnerable implementation calls it whenever keyring is non-NULL. The Logic section does not describe the completion/cleanup condition for the link operation or any behavior specific to either version. Its statements about validation, attempted linking, single instantiation, negative instantiation, expiry/GC, authorization-key revocation, and waking waiters are shared by both implementations.
